item.title: Discipling Children Biblically: Five Gospel-Centered Commitments for Parents
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins addresses one of the most important callings God has given to Christian parents: discipling their children according to the Word of God. Drawing from Deuteronomy 6:6–7, Dave explains that biblical discipleship does not begin in the teenage years, nor is it outsourced to the church, school, or culture. item.title: Psalm 7 Explained: Trusting God’s Justice When You Are Falsely Accused
item.description: Psalm 7 is a prayer for justice in the face of false accusation, slander, and oppression. Rather than seeking revenge, David entrusts himself to the Lord—the righteous Judge of all the earth. item.title: Training Children in the Lord: A Biblical Vision for Christian Parenting
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins presents a biblical vision for Christian parenting rooted in Ephesians 6:4. Parents are called to shape their children’s hearts with the gospel, form their character through Scripture, guide behavior with loving discipline, and model daily discipleship in Christ.
